# Registry

**Generated by `npm run registry` from `server/registry/`. Do not edit by hand** --
`npm test` fails when this file and the registries disagree. Change the registry,
then re-render.

Every environment variable, HTTP route, worker message, npm script and error code
this repo has. If something is not here, it does not exist.

## Environment

Read by the OPTIONAL server only -- the extension reads no environment at all.
`server/config.ts` reads through this list and nothing else.

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | _(unset)_ | The only credential this repo takes, and it NEVER ships in the extension: a browser extension bundle is readable by anyone who installs it, so the Claude read lives behind HTTP instead. Unset means the deterministic verdict still works and the agenda read reports itself unavailable. |
| `BOT_DETECTOR_PORT` | `3200` | The port the optional server binds. |
| `BOT_DETECTOR_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | `chrome-extension://,http://localhost,http://127.0.0.1` | Comma-separated CORS allowlist. An entry matches exactly, or as a bare scheme prefix ending in `://` (so `chrome-extension://` covers the extension without pinning a per-install id). The default is for local use only; if this is ever exposed on a hostname, narrow it to the exact `chrome-extension://<id>` and put the hostname behind an identity challenge. |
| `BOT_DETECTOR_DB_PATH` | `data/cache.db` | The SQLite cache file, relative to the repo root. A rebuildable cache rather than operational state, which is what makes "delete it" safe. |
| `BOT_DETECTOR_PROFILE_TTL_SECONDS` | `21600` | How long a cached profile lives. Profiles hold comment BODIES, so this is a data-retention bound and not only a performance knob: expiry is a physical DELETE, not a read-time filter. |
| `BOT_DETECTOR_VERDICT_TTL_SECONDS` | `86400` | How long a deterministic verdict is reused. A verdict is a pure function of the profile, so this only skips the archive round trip. |
| `BOT_DETECTOR_LLM_TTL_SECONDS` | `1209600` | How long a Claude agenda read is reused. Much longer than the verdict TTL on purpose: the read costs real money and an account’s agenda moves over weeks, not hours. |
| `BOT_AGENDA_MODEL` | `claude-opus-5` | The model for the agenda read. Opus rather than a cheap model because this is the one judgement call pattern-matching cannot make -- stock talking points versus an opinion someone genuinely holds -- and a cheap model gets it wrong confidently. |
| `BOT_AGENDA_MAX_COMMENTS` | `60` | How many of an account’s comments go into one pack. Caps token cost and, just as much, how much of a stranger’s history is shipped to a third party in one request. |
| `BOT_AGENDA_MAX_COMMENT_CHARS` | `700` | Per-comment body budget. Long comments are truncated with a marker rather than dropped, so citation ids stay stable. |
| `BOT_AGENDA_MAX_TOKENS` | `8000` | Output budget for the agenda read. THINKING COUNTS AGAINST THIS as well as the JSON, which is why it is well above what the report itself needs. A max_tokens stop fails loudly rather than handing back truncated JSON. |

## Routes

`server/index.ts` dispatches by looking a request up in this table. A path it does
not carry is a 404; one asked with another method is a 405.

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/health` | Liveness, plus whether an agenda read is available and the cache stats. `agenda` is a boolean about configuration and never the key itself; the extension’s options page renders it as "an LLM read is available". |
| `POST` | `/api/verdict` | Score one account. `{platform, username, deep?}`. Answers the deterministic verdict always; `deep` adds the Claude agenda read. An agenda failure is folded into the verdict as `agenda.llmError` rather than failing the request, because the deterministic half is unaffected by it. |

## Worker messages

The extension’s one internal boundary: content scripts never fetch, they ask the
service worker. Every reply is `{ok: true, data}` or
`{ok: false, error: {message, code, kind}}`.

| Message | Request | Reply | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BD_LOOKUP` | `{platform, username, deep?, force?}` | `{verdict, provider, degraded, degradedReason?, cached}` | Score one account. `degraded` is true when a configured backend was unreachable and the worker fell back to local scoring -- which it always reports, because local and backend mode are otherwise indistinguishable from the outside. |
| `BD_STATUS` | `{}` | `{mode, backendUrl, backendDown, settings, queue, cache}` | What the toolbar popup renders: which provider produced the verdicts on screen, the queue depth, the cache size. |
| `BD_CLEAR_CACHE` | `{}` | `{cleared}` | Drop every cached verdict. The cache is rebuildable by definition, so this is always safe. |
| `BD_CLEAR_LOG` | `{}` | `{cleared}` | Drop the signal log the options page shows. |
| `BD_GET_LOG` | `{}` | `{entries, max}` | Read the signal log, newest first, capped at `max`. |
| `BD_PROBE_BACKEND` | `{url}` | `{ok, agenda, error?}` | Probe a candidate backend URL from the options page before it is saved. |

## Commands

Read out of `package.json`, so this list cannot disagree with the scripts it names.

| Command | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run start` | `node server/index.ts` |
| `npm run dev` | `node --watch server/index.ts` |
| `npm run typecheck` | `node scripts/typecheck.js` |
| `npm run test` | `npm run typecheck && node --test test/*.test.js test/*.test.cjs server/test/*.test.js` |
| `npm run registry` | `node scripts/render-registry.js` |
| `npm run evaluate` | `node scripts/evaluate.mjs` |
| `npm run capture:corpus` | `node scripts/capture-corpus.mjs` |
| `npm run measure:agenda-shape` | `node scripts/measure-agenda-shape.mjs` |
| `npm run measure:band-edge` | `node scripts/measure-band-edge.mjs` |
| `npm run measure:interval-crossing` | `node scripts/measure-interval-crossing.mjs` |
| `npm run measure:interval-cv` | `node scripts/measure-interval-cv.mjs` |
| `npm run measure:prolific-humans` | `node scripts/probe-prolific-humans.mjs` |
| `npm run measure:quoted-titles` | `node scripts/measure-quoted-titles.mjs` |
| `npm run measure:reply-share` | `node scripts/measure-reply-share.mjs` |

## Errors

From `extension/errors.js`, the one taxonomy. A caller branches on `code`, never on
the message; `status` is what the optional server answers with.

| Code | Domain | Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `not-found` | lookup | 404 | No archive data for the account (deleted, suspended, or a typo). |
| `core-mismatch` | lookup | 500 | The scoring core loaded but does not match the expected interface. |
| `bad-profile` | scoring | 400 | scoreAccount() was called without an AccountProfile. |
| `no-fetch-impl` | source | 500 | No fetch implementation was available to fetchAccount(). |
| `request-ceiling` | source | 429 | One lookup hit its hard request ceiling. |
| `archive-request-failed` | source | 502 | An archive request failed and is not retryable. |
| `queue-full` | worker | 503 | The lookup queue is at its cap; a long thread queues rather than floods. |
| `worker-silent` | worker | 503 | The extension worker did not answer a message. |
| `worker-reloaded` | worker | 503 | The extension was reloaded or unloaded under a live page. |
| `worker-messaging` | worker | 503 | chrome.runtime.sendMessage failed for a reason the page cannot fix. |
| `backend-error` | backend | 502 | The configured backend answered with something unusable. |
| `rate-limited` | backend | 429 | The backend asked us to slow down; the queue backoff, not the UI, handles this. |
| `no-api-key` | agenda | 503 | ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset, so the agenda read is unavailable. |
| `sdk-missing` | agenda | 503 | @anthropic-ai/sdk is not installed, so the agenda read is unavailable. |
| `empty-pack` | agenda | 503 | The evidence pack has no comments in it. |
| `refusal` | agenda | 503 | The model declined to read the account (safety refusal). |
| `max-tokens` | agenda | 503 | The read hit max_tokens before finishing rather than returning partial JSON. |
| `no-text-block` | agenda | 503 | The model response carried no text block. |
| `unparseable` | agenda | 503 | The model's JSON response did not parse. |
| `body-too-large` | http | 413 | The request body exceeded the server’s cap. |
| `body-not-object` | http | 400 | The request body parsed but is not a JSON object. |
| `body-not-json` | http | 400 | The request body was not valid JSON. |
| `bad-request` | http | 400 | A request field failed validation before anything was fetched. |
| `method-not-allowed` | http | 405 | A known route was asked with a method it does not serve. |
| `not-a-route` | http | 404 | No route in the ROUTES table matches the path. |
| `origin-not-allowed` | http | 403 | The request Origin is not in the CORS allowlist. |
| `no-profile` | pack | 400 | buildPack() was called without a profile. |
| `deterministic-unavailable` | deterministic | 503 | The scoring core the server borrows from the extension could not be loaded. |
